items.author: Daniel Halle, playable Doom running inside Tableau Cloud, Nov 13
items.summary: He had Claude build a Data App that runs Doom, hosted inside Tableau Cloud's governed architecture. It's a fun stress test of how far Data Apps go past dashboards. 6 reactions, 3 comments, 1 repost.

items.author: Chris Westlake (2024 Iron Viz Champion), Marathon Majors viz built as a Data App in about 30 minutes, Nov 13
items.summary: He rebuilt his Tableau Public style as a Data App ("6573 DAYS" dot-matrix chart) and says doing the same build natively would take hacks and far more time. 9 reactions, 2 comments.

items.author: Adam Mico, Superstore Data App improved with the plugin's Viz Critique skill, Nov 13
items.summary: Claude built the app through the Tableau connector. Viz Critique scored it 7.1, and after changes it scored 8.4. The app now leads with a finding: discounts above 20% lose $136K on $365K of sales. Setup details are in his comments. 68 reactions, 22 comments, 1 repost.

items.author: Yazan Inaim (Snowflake), Tableau-to-Streamlit Cortex Code skill in public preview, Nov 14
items.summary: The skill converts a Tableau workbook into a multipage Streamlit-in-Snowflake app: calculations become Snowflake SQL, and filters and parameters become widgets. It gives customers a way to migrate off Tableau. 2 reactions.

items.author: Raj R., agentic framework that designs, repairs and audits Power BI reports, Nov 13
items.summary: It runs over 200 checks against about 1,800 rules, with a human-approved PR learning loop, and he pitches it as governed AI-assisted delivery. 19 reactions, 10 comments.

items.author: Gus Bavia (2026 Power BI World Champion), freight "load planner" dashboard built with AI agents, Nov 13
items.summary: It has drag-and-drop trailer bays and axle-weight bars, with the SVG built using AI agents in VS Code. His UX tip: when you block an action, offer the nearest valid one. 34 reactions.

items.author: Baharudin Seid, the "dashboard graveyard," Nov 13
items.summary: A Sr Director argues that bolting AI onto legacy BI only grows the graveyard of unused dashboards, and makes the case for autonomous analytics. 4 reactions, 1 comment.

items.author: Ben Jones, Powered by Data podcast on dbt Charts, Nov 13
items.summary: dbt Charts is "markdown for dashboards": YAML files that sit next to dbt models and are validated on the branch. Guests are Dave Fowler and RJ Andrews. 6 reactions, 1 repost.
